text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So many Umamusume fans are watching me! 
That's why—that's why—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Run toward the stands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital! It's Agnes Digital! In the 
pouring rain, look at that unique line 
she's taking—!? And now—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line now! A victory so 
decisive no one can dispute it! She has 
conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gag*, *pant*, *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhhh...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Howaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-O-O-FOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: FWOOOOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital screams out of pure 
excitement. Even if it couldn't form 
proper words, her scream was packed to the 
brim with sheer joy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, an unknown... an unknown 
catharsis is coming over meee...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I look up to... I'll deliver 
victory to the two of them...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I always thought there was no way I could 
do it. That's why I pinned all my wishes 
on my favorite...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But that very same me...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ph-Phoooooh! What are you saying, 
Trainer-san?! I-I am, I'm just~~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, fan service as a thank-you!! 
Trainer, do you want some of my tail 
hair?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital was so overly excited she 
tried to hand me some bizarre souvenir, 
but I dragged her over to the winner's 
circle anyway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
H-H-Hello there! I'm Agnes Digital! To 
begin with, I'm just an ordinary Umamusume 
fan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And chasing after that butt... wait, no, 
that back! is how I made it all the way 
here, so...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand this profound emotion, 
hmm!? I'm not just some ordinary 
Umamusume. I used to be merely a fan, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That... is the sheer blessing of crossing 
the finish line in first place, immersed 
in all this preciousness...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I won because I'm not just me 
anymore. I'm the culmination of every 
Umamusume I've ever met! A concept 
incarnate...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Every single Umamusume who helped me grow 
into who I am today is the reason I won 
today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Such a blessing... Thank you, truly...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume-chan is hundreds, nay, tens of 
thousands of times more wonderful than I 
ever imagined back when I was just a 
fan...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how should I put it... The difference 
in the history we've walked really showed.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
On this rough track, I took the royal 
road, and Doto steadily persevered. But...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To her, the entire turf was an open path. 
Drawing on experience, she freely chose 
the easiest ground to run on.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That is the path shown to me by so many 
Umamusume. The reason I was able to follow 
it is..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because she's a true all-rounder. Just for 
today, I'll take off my crown.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
By the way everyone, I'm flattered, but 
did you see Opera O-san today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it wonderful? That short hair 
swaying so gallantly! And the way her eyes 
narrow sharply on the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Doto-san's bag! It looks 
so good on her. The angle of that swing is 
just so precious, gahhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And though she couldn't race today, 
there's my fave underclassman! I wanna run 
with that girl someday, on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And there are still so many more charming 
Umamusume out there! On a grand stage like 
this, how could I not introduce them 
all?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please stay with us until the 
very end! Fwoooooo!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Agnes Digital-san, that's enough 
around there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly became overwhelmed with 
emotion as she spoke, and lost control of 
herself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's just like her. The 
strongest all-rounder is dragged away by 
the staff members..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Wait—, one last thing! At least let me 
say this much at the endーーー!!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume-chan, you are the ABSOLUTE 
BESTTTT!!!!
